stem.text: Three identical lamps $\text{L}_1$, $\text{L}_2$ and $\text{L}_3$ are connected to a battery with negligible internal resistance, as shown.

stem.text: What happens to the brightness of lamps $\text{L}_1$ and $\text{L}_2$ when the switch S is closed?
